title: ScriptedDeployService
responsibility: Prepares immutable artifacts and routes guarded deploy, rollback, sign-off and recovery on the trusted host.

inputs.name: ScriptedDeployService.constructor.registry
inputs.description: Trusted deploy registry, including approved targets, executable paths and signer public keys.

inputs.name: ScriptedDeployService.constructor.project
inputs.description: Project name registered on the trusted deploy host.

inputs.name: ScriptedDeployService.constructor.config
inputs.description: Reviewed project or target settings for this operation.

inputs.name: ScriptedDeployService.prepare.source
inputs.description: Full Git commit expected to be reachable from the configured remote branch.

inputs.name: ScriptedDeployService.deploy.input
inputs.description: Typed request or persisted JSON payload for this operation.

inputs.name: ScriptedDeployService.signoff.id
inputs.description: Opaque identity of the stored release or deployment run requested.

inputs.name: ScriptedDeployService.signoff.proof
inputs.description: Signed approval or sign-off envelope to verify.

outputs.name: ScriptedDeployService.prepare
outputs.description: Prepares immutable release artifacts and executes one guarded deploy or rollback through the trusted broker.

outputs.name: ScriptedDeployService.deploy
outputs.description: Prepares immutable release artifacts and executes one guarded deploy or rollback through the trusted broker.

outputs.name: ScriptedDeployService.signoff
outputs.description: Prepares immutable release artifacts and executes one guarded deploy or rollback through the trusted broker.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The operation could not verify its input, target identity, or expected result.
